## What this lands

- **Camera-site predicate family** (`connectors/src/connectors/osm.py`)
  — every element carrying `surveillance:type` or
  `highway=speed_camera` (node or way; way `center` for
  geometry) emits `camera_external_ref = osm:<type>/<id>` +
  candidate `{scheme: "osm.element"}` (the declared shared
  namespace), `camera_latitude`/`camera_longitude`,
  `camera_coordinate_source = osm`, `camera_jurisdiction =
  sig.unresolved` until PKG-06b, `camera_name`/`camera_roadway`/
  `camera_direction` where tagged, `camera_operator` through
  `partner_ref_rows` — **organisations only** (a person-shaped
  value stays on `operator_stated`, never mints a person), and
  `technology` through P35.15b's machinery (`alpr-fixed`,
  `alpr-mobile`, `ate-speed` for `highway=speed_camera`,
  `face-recognition-unspecified`).
- **Mapper-identity stop (SIG-INGEST-045e)** — every widened
  query prints `out body center qt;` — `out meta` is never
  requested — and `parse()` refuses elements still carrying
  `user`/`uid` **before the capture bytes land**. Edit
  detection moves to `element_content_digest` +
  `snapshot_content_diff`; `version` stays optional.
- **Tiled national/global passes** —
  `data/osm_area_tiles.toml` (`sig.osm-area-tiles/1`, 299
  declared areas: 50 US states + DC, ISO countries) drives
  `out count;` discovery then `out body center qt;` per
  non-empty area (180 s fetch timeout, ≈30 s pacing,
  `rate_limit_per_min = 2` on the discovery targets),
  `discover_more` resolving counts to fetch targets with a
  `ContentDrift` reconciliation (2 % / floor 2 — SIG-ENG-042).
  The OKC bbox stays one target; `live_targets.toml`'s OKC
  query widened to node/way/relation + the widened selectors.
- **RF-derived coarsening** — `source`/`survey` tags naming
  Wi-Fi/BLE/RF detection coarsen to 3-decimal coordinates on
  claims **and** `physical_asset` geometry until the
  SIG-PUB-011–014 residential screen lands.
- **ER-pool admission** —
  `resolution/src/resolution/camera_sites_pg.py` `_TARGETS_SQL`
  additively admits `osm:%` subjects alongside
  `traffic_camera:%`.
- **Fixtures + shadow diff** — an OKC `out body` slice, an
  ≈200-element state tile, an `out count` response, and a
  pre-fix meta-shaped negative control; the shadow ER run over
  40 registry/OSM record pairs merges **39/40 (97.5 %,
  tier ≤ 3)** — above the ≥95 % bar; the one non-merge is a
  deliberate direction conflict left `proposed` for review.
